card.fires_on: Partway through long or unusual drug names, on a middle or ending piece such as -in, -iz, -aca or -ide. Mostly generic and brand names in interaction tables and dose text.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: A middle or late piece of a long generic or brand drug name, with more of the name still to come or just completed.

modes.label: Other odd names
modes.description: A piece inside a rare proper name or command, outside drug text.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long, unfamiliar drug names as the model reads through them.
